qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Project tenders are competitively bid on hourly rates across engineering consultancies; margins (~10%) depend on consultant utilization and wage pass-through rather than structural pricing power. No proprietary IP, network effects, or customer switching lock-in.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat Archetype None, REJECT). Leading European engineering and architectural consultancy, but operates a billable-hour professional services model characterized by competitive project bidding, low customer switching costs, and cyclical reliance on construction and public infrastructure procurement. Also faces long-term headwind from AI-assisted CAD/BIM design tools compressing billable engineering hours.
qualitative.evidence: Sweco generates SEK 31.6B in net sales with EBITA margins capped at ~10-10.5% (SEK 3,332M in FY25) and billing ratio of 74.4%. Contracts are project-based and competitively tendered against peers like AFRY, WSP, and Arcadis without customer lock-in or proprietary data barriers. Pricing reflects labor rate inflation pass-through rather than structural economic rent extraction.
